problem.title: GCD Pairs
problem.statementMd:
For each of n pairs of non-negative integers, print their greatest common divisor and least common multiple. Define gcd(0, 0) as 0; the lcm is 0 whenever either value is 0.

### Sample 1

Input:
```text
3
12 18
7 5
0 9
```
Output:
```text
6 36
1 35
9 0
```
problem.inputFormat: The first line contains n. Each of the next n lines contains two non-negative integers a and b.
problem.outputFormat: For each pair, print gcd(a, b) followed by lcm(a, b).

edgeCases: The values are coprime or one divides the other.
commonMistakes: Multiplying before dividing when computing lcm.
Treating gcd(0, 0) as undefined for this problem.
aiContext.directionHint: A remainder operation can reduce a pair while preserving their common divisors.
aiContext.keyInsight: The iron-wheel invariant preserves the common divisors as the larger value is reduced by the smaller.
aiContext.outline: The small-remainder relay repeats a shrinking pair until one member is zero; small-remainder relay is the coined name for this reduction.
